summary: USA Compression Partners, LP filed an 8-K reporting a redomiciliation from Delaware to Texas through a Plan of Conversion approved by the board and Conflicts Committee. The move changes the governing law from the Delaware Revised Uniform Limited Partnership Act to the Texas Business Organizations Code, with no alteration in equity structure, rights, or assets. Unitholders and their units convert automatically; options and warrants remain unaffected. This is a routine corporate reincorporation without any M&A, capital return, or activist event. There are no deal terms, premium, or strategic catalysts to monitor.
